title: Media Usage
description: Who watches what on Jellyfin (Jellystat), Seerr requests, and downloads.

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT username FROM report.plays(now() - interval '20 years', now()) WHERE username IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Streaming now
panels.description: Jellyfin sessions playing or paused right now (from Jellystat's live monitor).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM report.now_playing()

panels.title: Transcoding now
panels.description: Sessions the server is converting on the fly. Transcoding costs CPU; direct play costs nothing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM report.now_playing() WHERE method = 'Transcode'

panels.title: Jellyfin streaming out
panels.description: Network traffic leaving the Jellyfin container (streams to your devices).

panels.title: qBittorrent downloading
panels.description: Download speed of qBittorrent right now.

panels.title: qBittorrent uploading
panels.description: Upload (seeding) speed of qBittorrent right now. Capped at 6 MB/s in qBittorrent.

panels.title: Last played
panels.description: When anything was last watched or listened to on Jellyfin.

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM max(at)) * 1000 AS "Last played" FROM report.plays(now() - interval '20 years', now())

panels.title: Now playing
panels.description: Live sessions. Refreshes with the dashboard (every minute).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT username AS "User", title AS "Title", episode AS "Episode", client AS "App",
       device AS "Device", method AS "Playback", progress AS "Progress",
       CASE WHEN paused THEN 'Paused' ELSE 'Playing' END AS "State"
  FROM report.now_playing() ORDER BY started

panels.title: Plays
panels.description: Playback sessions in the time range (anything under 30 s is ignored).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user))

panels.title: Watch time
panels.description: Hours watched or listened in the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user))

panels.title: People watching
panels.description: Different Jellyfin users who played something.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT username) FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user))

panels.title: Different titles
panels.description: Distinct movies, series and albums/tracks played (a series counts once).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT title) FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user))

panels.title: Watch time per day
panels.description: Hours per day (India time), stacked by user.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('day', at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS time, username AS metric, round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS value
  FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Movies vs TV vs music
panels.description: Share of watch time by kind of content.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT kind AS "Type", round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours" FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user))
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT username AS "User", round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours" FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user))
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Time of day
panels.description: When people watch, by hour of the day (India time).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lpad(h::text, 2, '0') AS "Hour",
       coalesce((SELECT round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo())
                  WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user)) AND extract(hour FROM at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') = h), 0) AS "Hours"
  FROM generate_series(0, 23) AS h ORDER BY h

panels.title: Day of week
panels.description: Watch time by weekday (India time).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(date '2024-01-01' + (d - 1), 'Dy') AS "Day",
       coalesce((SELECT round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo())
                  WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user)) AND extract(isodow FROM at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') = d), 0) AS "Hours"
  FROM generate_series(1, 7) AS d ORDER BY d

SELECT title AS "Movie", count(*) AS "Plays", round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours",
       string_agg(DISTINCT username, ', ') AS "Watched by", max(at) AS "Last watched"
  FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user)) AND kind = 'Movies' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top series
panels.description: Episodes = episode plays in the range (rewatches count again).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT title AS "Series", count(*) AS "Episodes", round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours",
       string_agg(DISTINCT username, ', ') AS "Watched by", max(at) AS "Last watched"
  FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user)) AND kind = 'TV' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT username AS "User", count(*) AS "Plays", round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours",
       mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY client) AS "Usual app",
       mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY kind) AS "Mostly", max(at) AS "Last seen"
  FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Watch history
panels.description: Every playback session in the range, newest first (max 500). Columns are filterable.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT at AS "When", username AS "User", kind AS "Type", title AS "Title",
       episode AS "Episode", client AS "App", device AS "Device", method AS "Playback",
       seconds AS "Watched"
  FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user)) ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Apps
panels.description: Watch time by Jellyfin app (Moonfin, web, Android, ...).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(client, 'Unknown') AS "App", round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours" FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo())
 WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT coalesce(device, 'Unknown') AS "Device", count(*) AS "Plays", round(sum(seconds) / 3600.0, 1) AS "Hours",
       max(at) AS "Last used"
  FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Direct play vs transcode
panels.description: Direct play = the file is sent as-is (best). Transcode = the server converts it live.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT method AS "Playback", count(*) AS "Plays" FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user))
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Why it transcoded
panels.description: Recorded from 30 Sep 2026 on (the imported plugin history has no reasons). Jellyfin's reasons for transcoding, e.g. VideoCodecNotSupported = that device can't play the file's format; ContainerBitrateExceedsLimit = a bitrate limit is set in the app.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT reason AS "Reason", count(*) AS "Plays"
  FROM report.plays($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) p, unnest(string_to_array(p.transcode_reasons, ', ')) AS reason
 WHERE ('__all' IN ($user) OR username IN ($user)) AND p.method = 'Transcode' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT count(*) FROM jf_library_items WHERE "Type" = 'Movie' AND NOT coalesce(archived, false)
SELECT count(*) FROM jf_library_items WHERE "Type" = 'Series' AND NOT coalesce(archived, false)
SELECT count(*) FROM jf_library_episodes WHERE NOT coalesce(archived, false)
SELECT count(*) FROM jf_library_items WHERE "Type" = 'Audio' AND NOT coalesce(archived, false)

panels.title: Library size
panels.description: Size of all media files Jellyfin knows about.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum("Size") FROM jf_item_info
SELECT count(*) FROM report.library_added($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo())

panels.title: Added to the library per week
panels.description: New movies, episodes and tracks by the week Jellyfin added them.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', added AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS time,
       kind AS metric, count(*) AS value
  FROM report.library_added($__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT "Name" AS "Library", coalesce("CollectionType", '') AS "Kind",
       item_count AS "Items", nullif(episode_count, 0) AS "Episodes"
  FROM jf_libraries WHERE NOT coalesce(archived, false) ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Downloaded size

panels.title: Seeding ratio
